title_block.title: PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 9
title_block.sheet_note: PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 9 - View A. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 59, 61; PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 9 - View B. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 75, 96, 97; PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 9 - View C. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 82; PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 9 - View D. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 81, 95, 98
title_block.standard: ASME Y14.5M-1994 (dimensioning and tolerancing); ASME Y14.41-2003 (dataset)

features.label: whole plate
features.description: The sheet-metal plate as a whole. General notes apply to all of it.

features.label: three holes near the back left (3X)
features.description: Three round holes near the back left edge of the plate in view A; the leader points to one of them.

features.label: hole at the left end
features.description: Round hole near the left end of the plate in view A. Its axis is datum feature C.

features.label: top face of the plate
features.description: The large flat top face of the plate (view A). It is datum feature A.

features.label: two short slots near the back edge (2X)
features.description: The two shorter straight slots with round ends near the back edge of the plate (view B).

features.label: large cutout in the middle
features.description: Large roughly rectangular through cutout with round lobes at its corners, in the middle of the plate (view B).

features.label: round hole with a key notch
features.description: Round through hole with a small key notch on one side, seen enlarged in view C. Its axis is datum feature G.

features.label: two holes with dual-unit callout (2X)
features.description: Two round holes in the right half of the plate in view D, the ones dimensioned in both inches and millimetres.

features.label: two small holes near the front left (2X)
features.description: The lower pair of small round holes near the large hole at the front left of view D.

values.meaning: Each of the three holes may be .250 in in diameter at least and .253 in at most (tolerance only upward).
The hole diameter must be .234 in plus or minus .008 in, so between .226 and .242 in.
Flatness: every point of the plate's top face must lie between two parallel planes .01 in apart; no datum is used.
Datum feature A: the plate's top face is the primary reference. The symbol hangs from the flatness frame that controls this face.

values.raw: 5. MATERIAL: (.1195 THICK) 11 GA 304 SST SHT, ASTM A240.
values.meaning: General note 5: the part is 11 gauge (.1195 in thick) type 304 stainless steel sheet to ASTM A240.
Each of the two short slots must be 1.00 in long plus or minus .02 in, so between .98 and 1.02 in.

values.applies_to: the whole outline of the cutout (all-around circle on the leader)
values.meaning: Profile of a surface, all around: the cutout's walls must lie in a .02 in band around their true shape, located from datum A and from datum feature F at its maximum material boundary.

values.applies_to: top row of a two-frame stack under ⌀.375 ±.008
values.meaning: Position: the axis of the keyed hole must lie in a .040 in diameter cylinder at its true position from datums A, B and C.

values.applies_to: the bracketed values repeat the size in millimetres (note 4)
values.meaning: Each of the two holes must be .315 in plus or minus .008 in, so between .307 and .323 in; the bracket gives the same size in millimetres, 8 mm plus or minus 0.2 mm.

values.applies_to: the two holes as their own pattern (SEP REQT: separate requirement)
values.meaning: Position at maximum material condition, separate requirement: the axes of the two holes must each lie in a .025 in diameter cylinder at true position from datum A and datum features D and E at maximum material boundary, checked separately from the other hole pair that uses the same frame.
